# Agentix

> Agentix is a browser-local portfolio tracker for monitoring agents, manually recording daily calls and earnings, and reviewing performance grades.

Canonical site: https://agentix.suedeai.ai
Suede Agent Studio: https://agents.suedeai.ai

## Important data note

The 18 public agent profiles and their earnings figures are deterministic illustrative examples shown until an operator adds their own data. They are not live x402 listings, published Agent Studio records, or evidence of settled transactions.
